name: Casa
author: NucleoOS
description: A dashboard for Home Assistant: lights, plugs, covers, thermostats, locks, media players, vacuums, scenes and sensors, by room. Live updates; unlocking asks first.

descriptions.en: A dashboard for Home Assistant: lights, plugs, covers, thermostats, locks, media players, vacuums, scenes and sensors, by room. Live updates; unlocking asks first.
descriptions.it: Una dashboard per Home Assistant: luci, prese, tapparelle, termostati, serrature, lettori, robot aspirapolvere, scene e sensori, per stanza. Aggiornata in diretta; per sbloccare chiede conferma.
descriptions.es: Un panel para Home Assistant: luces, enchufes, persianas, termostatos, cerraduras, reproductores, robots aspiradores, escenas y sensores, por habitación. En directo; desbloquear pide confirmación.
descriptions.fr: Un tableau de bord pour Home Assistant : lumières, prises, volets, thermostats, serrures, lecteurs, robots aspirateurs, scènes et capteurs, par pièce. En direct ; déverrouiller demande confirmation.
descriptions.de: Ein Dashboard für Home Assistant: Lichter, Steckdosen, Rollläden, Thermostate, Schlösser, Player, Saugroboter, Szenen und Sensoren, nach Raum. Live; Entriegeln fragt nach.
